title: Modelled tax and benefit measures
description: Measures modelled from the HMRC ready reckoner: rows used, unit of change, sign convention, scope limit and the current rate verified by an exact quote on gov.uk.
notes:
points_up/points_down list 'size=section::label(+...)' ready-reckoner rows (values summed) costed for a change of that size; sign_up/sign_down turn those £m into Exchequer revenue (+ = more revenue); an empty points_down mirrors the increase. max_change is the scope gate's hard limit in the measure's unit. current_value was verified on 2026-11-08 by the quotes in current_quote.
